card.name: Safety warning phrases before reported events
card.fires_on: The word just before a warning statement continues, such as 'have' in 'have been reported', 'suicidal' or 'SUICIDAL<ITY>', or 'events'/'reactions' after a serious-reaction term. It appears in boxed warnings and Warnings and Precautions sections.

modes.label: Suicidality warnings
modes.description: The word 'suicidal' or the ending of 'SUICIDALITY' in antidepressant and antiepileptic warnings.

modes.label: Have been reported
modes.description: The word 'have' after a serious adverse event, just before 'been reported in patients'.
modes.example: Severe liver injury and acute liver failure, in some cases fatal,<< have>> been reported in patients treated with propyl

modes.label: Event noun in warning heading
modes.description: A noun such as 'events' or 'reactions' that ends a named adverse-event phrase.
modes.example: 5 WARNINGS AND PRECAUTIONS Serious asthma-related<< events>>: Long-acting beta 2 -
